This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

Perfect for a simple weeknight dinner.  🛒INGREDIENTS: • 2 packs Knorr Broccoli & Cheddar Rice • 2 cans reduced-sodium Cream of Chicken • Chicken broth, using the 2 empty soup cans to measure • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 bag frozen broccoli  • Shredded cheddar cheese 🧂SEASONINGS:  • Chicken seasoning (I used Chicka Licka Bam)  • Garlic powder • Onion powder • Paprika • Dried parsley 👩‍🍳HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35 minutes. 8. Remove the foil and sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the top. 9. Return to the oven and bake uncovered for about 10 minutes.   10. ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. 🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

 Serves 2 
 
 350g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 2cm pieces 
 1 tbsp rice wine 
 1 tsp corn flour
 1 tsp light soy sauce 
 1 tbsp groundnut oil 
 1 onion, thinly sliced 
 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped 
 4 spring onions, finely chopped 
 1 tsp sesame oil 
 Rice to serve 
 
 For the sauce 
 2 tbsp water 
 1 tbsp oyster sauce
 2 tsp dark soy sauce 
 1 tsp light soy sauce 
 1 ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper 
 1 tsp corn flour 
 
 1.	Pop the chicken into a mixing bowl and add the rice wine, corn flour and light soy. Mix well and set to one side whilst you whisk together all the ingredients for the sauce in a little bowl. 
 2.	Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 3 minutes until a little golden. Add the onion and stir fry for 3-4 minutes or until the chicken is cooked. You can add a little extra oil if you need. Pop in the garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds until fragrant. Pour over the sauce and stir-fry together. Remove from the heat and add the spring onions and sesame oil, stir together and serve immediately with rice.
